items.title: The web is always talking: Link pings, Beacon, CSP
items.content_text: Image from Unsplash.com by Mostafa Moraji In the modern web ecosystem , pages are not just rendered — user interactions are tracked and analyzed to optimize user experience, and gather insights. When you click a link on a website, something else may happen besides navigation. When you close a tab, something might still be sent. Most users never see this traffic.
